title: Multimodal Model Architectures
summary: This module encompasses various multimodal model architectures that integrate and process different data types like text, image, and video for diverse tasks.

nodes.label: BLIP Family Models
nodes.title: BLIP Family Models
nodes.description: Contains models based on the BLIP architecture, integrating vision and language components for tasks like image captioning and visual question answering.

nodes.label: BridgeTower Models
nodes.title: BridgeTower Models
nodes.description: Includes BridgeTower models designed for contrastive learning and image-text retrieval by bridging vision and language modalities.

nodes.label: Qwen MoE Models
nodes.title: Qwen Mixture-of-Experts Models
nodes.description: Houses Qwen models utilizing Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures, including specialized text and talker models for diverse modalities.

nodes.label: Other Multimodal Architectures
nodes.title: Diverse Multimodal Architectures
nodes.description: A collection of other distinct multimodal models such as Kosmos2, Mllama, and XCLIP, each offering unique approaches to multimodal understanding.

groups.label: Core Multimodal Models
groups.title: Core Multimodal Models
groups.description: Central implementations of various multimodal architectures that process and integrate data from multiple modalities.
